Core Operations & Facilities

An integrated supply chain across multiple agricultural domains.

Poultry Breeding

Distributes millions of high-performing day-old chicks across Nigeria, including Ross 308 broilers and Novogen Brown layers.

Animal Nutrition

Manufactures customized poultry premixes, feed additives, and specialized nutrition formulations for broilers, layers, aquaculture, and livestock.

Veterinary Supplies

Exclusive distributor for Phibro Animal Health (formerly Abic) vaccines and medications, ensuring superior livestock health across Nigeria.

Turnkey Farm Dev.

Designs, builds, and manages commercial poultry and aquaculture installations for third-party investors before handing over fully operational farms.

Organizational History

Decades of consistent growth and infrastructure expansion.

1991

Company Foundation

Founded in Nigeria by entrepreneur Chaim Zach to address national demand for protein. Core mission established around modern poultry breeding and agricultural tech transfer.

1993 – 2010s

Infrastructure Expansion

Maintained >20% average annual growth. Scaled operations by building White Plains Farm and Green Plains Farm (Oyo State), housing breeding stocks, feed mills, and automated hatcheries.

2012

Board Leadership Evolution

Former Deputy Governor of the CBN, Ernest C. Ebi (MFR), assumed the role of Chairman of the Board of Directors, strengthening corporate governance and strategic direction.

2015

Silver Plains Farm

Established in Ogun State to expand parent stock housing capacity for heavy breeders. Added large-scale grain and feed storage infrastructure (further expanded in 2016).

2018

Launch of Blue Plains

Launched in Fiditi, Oyo State (partnering with Agrotop). A biosecure hub housing over 200,000 parent stock and pullets, alongside a Pasreform hatchery incubating millions of eggs per batch.
